At the airport (Passport control).target: Next, please. Good morning. Passport, please.
At the airport (Passport control).native: Следующий, пожалуйста. Доброе утро. Паспорт, пожалуйста.

At the airport (Passport control).target: What is the purpose of your visit?
For one week. Until next Tuesday.
At the Grand Hotel in the city center.
At the airport (Passport control).native: В Гранд Отеле в центре города.

At the airport (Passport control).target: Do you have a return ticket?
Yes, I do. Here is the confirmation.
That's fine. How much cash do you have with you?
At the airport (Passport control).native: Хорошо. Сколько наличных денег у вас с собой?

At the airport (Passport control).target: About 500 euros and some credit cards.
At the airport (Passport control).native: Около 500 евро и несколько кредитных карт.

At the airport (Passport control).target: OK. Look into the camera, please. ... Thank you. Enjoy your trip.
At the airport (Passport control).native: Хорошо. Посмотрите в камеру, пожалуйста. ... Спасибо. Хорошей поездки.
